text.en: Wake baby up gently: say good morning and tell them what the weather is like today.
text.hinglish: Baby ko pyaar se jagaaiye: good morning kahiye aur bataaiye aaj mausam kaisa hai.

say.en: Good morning, my little sunshine! Today the sky is ___ and the air feels ___. Let's have a lovely day together.
say.hinglish: Suprabhat mere chhote suraj! Aaj aasmaan ___ hai aur hawa ___ lag rahi hai. Chalo saath mein pyaara din bitaate hain.

text.en: Hold your cup of tea or milk and describe its smell, colour and warmth to baby, slowly.
text.hinglish: Apna chai ya doodh ka cup pakadiye aur baby ko dheere-dheere uski khushboo, rang aur garmaahat bataaiye.

say.en: Can you smell this? It's warm and sweet, with a little elaichi. One day we'll sit together with our cups.
say.hinglish: Yeh khushboo aa rahi hai? Garam aur meethi, thodi elaichi wali. Ek din hum saath baithkar piyenge.

text.en: Introduce one family member to baby today, with one funny or sweet thing about them.
text.hinglish: Aaj parivaar ke ek sadasya se baby ki pehchaan karaaiye, unki ek mazedaar ya pyaari baat ke saath.

say.en: This is your Dadi. She makes the best churma, and she laughs so loudly that the whole house smiles.
say.hinglish: Yeh tumhaari Dadi hain. Sabse badhiya churma banaati hain, aur itna zor se hansti hain ki poora ghar muskura deta hai.

text.en: Count slowly from 1 to 10 with baby, tapping your belly softly on each number. Try it in Hindi and English.
text.hinglish: Baby ke saath 1 se 10 tak dheere giniye, har ginti par pet ko halke se thapthapaaiye. Hindi aur English dono mein.

say.en: Ek, do, teen… One, two, three… You and me, counting together. Ten little taps of love!
say.hinglish: Ek, do, teen… one, two, three… tum aur main, saath mein ginti. Pyaar ki das chhoti thapkiyan!

text.en: Hum or sing just one line of any song you love. Baby feels the hum in your body.
text.hinglish: Koi bhi pasandida gaana ki bas ek line gungunaaiye ya gaaiye. Baby aapke sharir mein gunjan mehsoos karta hai.

say.en: This is my favourite song, little one. I'll sing it to you every time you can't sleep.
say.hinglish: Yeh mera pasandida gaana hai, mere chhote. Jab bhi tumhe neend na aaye, main yahi gaaungi.

text.en: Look out of the window and describe to baby exactly what you see, like a little radio show.
text.hinglish: Khidki se bahar dekhiye aur baby ko bilkul waisa bataaiye jo dikh raha hai, jaise chhota sa radio program.

say.en: Outside our window there is a tree, a cow is walking slowly, and a bird just flew past. Hello, world!
say.hinglish: Hamaari khidki ke bahar ek ped hai, ek gaay dheere-dheere chal rahi hai, aur abhi ek chidiya udkar gayi. Namaste duniya!

text.en: Pick three things around you and tell baby their colours, one by one.
text.hinglish: Apne aas-paas ki teen cheezein chuniye aur baby ko ek-ek karke unke rang bataaiye.

say.en: My dupatta is pink, the leaves are green, and the sky is blue. The world is full of colours waiting for you.
say.hinglish: Meri chunni gulaabi hai, patte hare hain, aur aasmaan neela hai. Duniya rangon se bhari hai, tumhaara intezaar kar rahi hai.

text.en: When baby kicks or moves, press gently on that spot and talk back, like a little game.
text.hinglish: Jab baby laat maare ya hile, us jagah halke se dabaaiye aur jawaab dijiye, jaise chhota sa khel.

say.en: Was that you saying hello? Here's a hello back! Tap tap. Your turn now.
say.hinglish: Kya yeh tumhaara hello tha? Yeh lo mera hello! Thap thap. Ab tumhaari baari.

text.en: While you cook or watch food being made, tell baby the recipe step by step.
text.hinglish: Khaana banaate ya bante dekhte hue baby ko recipe ek-ek kadam bataaiye.

say.en: First the atta, then a little water, now we knead it soft. This is how we make warm rotis for the family.
say.hinglish: Pehle aata, phir thoda paani, ab naram goondhte hain. Aise hi parivaar ke liye garam rotiyan banti hain.

text.en: Tell baby one game you loved to play as a little girl.
text.hinglish: Baby ko bataaiye ki bachpan mein aapko kaun sa khel sabse pasand tha.

say.en: When I was small, I played gilli-danda and stapu with my friends until Maa called us home. I'll teach you too!
say.hinglish: Jab main chhoti thi, dosto ke saath stapu aur gilli-danda khelti thi jab tak Maa ghar na bulaati. Tumhe bhi sikhaaungi!

text.en: Tell baby three small things you are thankful for today.
text.hinglish: Baby ko aaj ki teen chhoti cheezein bataaiye jinke liye aap shukraguzaar hain.

say.en: Today I'm thankful for a good sleep, a sweet guava, and you, growing safely inside me.
say.hinglish: Aaj main shukraguzaar hoon achhi neend ke liye, ek meethe amrood ke liye, aur tumhaare liye, jo mere andar surakshit badh rahe ho.

text.en: Teach baby one new word today, in Hindi and English, and use it in a sentence.
text.hinglish: Aaj baby ko ek naya shabd sikhaaiye, Hindi aur English mein, aur use ek vaakya mein boliye.

say.en: Today's word is 'chaand', moon. Tonight the chaand is round and bright, just like your little face will be.
say.hinglish: Aaj ka shabd hai 'chaand', moon. Aaj raat chaand gol aur chamakdaar hai, bilkul tumhaare nanhe chehre jaisa.

text.en: Ask Papa to put his hand on your belly and say three sentences to baby. You can help him start.
text.hinglish: Papa se kahiye ki pet par haath rakhkar baby se teen vaakya bolein. Aap shuruaat mein madad kar sakti hain.

say.en: This deep voice is your Papa. He's a little shy, but he loves you so much already.
say.hinglish: Yeh bhaari awaaz tumhaare Papa ki hai. Thode sharmile hain, par tumse abhi se bahut pyaar karte hain.

text.en: Tell baby one wish you have for their life. Keep it simple and from the heart.
text.hinglish: Baby ko unki zindagi ke liye apni ek dua bataaiye. Seedhi aur dil se.

say.en: My wish for you is that you always have good friends, and that you laugh a lot, every single day.
say.hinglish: Meri dua hai ki tumhaare hamesha achhe dost hon, aur tum roz khoob hanso.

text.en: On a short, slow walk, tell baby every sound you hear: birds, bells, vehicles, people.
text.hinglish: Chhoti, dheemi sair par baby ko har awaaz bataaiye jo sunaai de: chidiyan, ghanti, gaadiyan, log.

say.en: Hear that? A tractor going to the fields. And that's the temple bell. Our village is waking up.
say.hinglish: Suna? Ek tractor khet ja raha hai. Aur yeh mandir ki ghanti. Hamaara gaon jaag raha hai.

text.en: Tell baby honestly how you feel today, even if it's tired. Then tell them it's okay.
text.hinglish: Baby ko sach bataaiye ki aaj aap kaisa mehsoos kar rahi hain, thakaan ho to woh bhi. Phir kahiye ki sab theek hai.

say.en: Today Mummy feels a little tired, and that's okay. We'll rest together. You're doing great in there.
say.hinglish: Aaj Mummy thodi thaki hai, aur yeh theek hai. Hum saath aaraam karenge. Tum andar bahut achha kar rahe ho.

text.en: Tell baby about the crops in the fields this season and what the farmers are doing.
text.hinglish: Baby ko is mausam ki faslon ke baare mein bataaiye aur kisaan kya kar rahe hain.

say.en: Right now the wheat is growing tall and green. Soon it will turn golden, and we will have fresh rotis from it.
say.hinglish: Abhi gehun lamba aur hara ho raha hai. Jaldi sunehra hoga, aur usse taazi rotiyan banengi.

text.en: Name the animals around your home and make their sounds for baby.
text.hinglish: Ghar ke aas-paas ke jaanwaron ke naam bataaiye aur baby ke liye unki awaaz nikaaliye.

say.en: The cow says moo, the buffalo says mmmh, the sparrow says chee-chee, and the dog says bhow-bhow!
say.hinglish: Gaay kehti hai baa, bhains kehti hai mmmh, chidiya kehti hai choon-choon, aur kutta kehta hai bhow-bhow!

text.en: Make up a tiny two-minute story with baby as the hero.
text.hinglish: Ek chhoti si do minute ki kahani banaaiye jismein baby hero ho.

say.en: Once upon a time, a brave little one helped a lost baby bird find its nest. And everyone clapped!
say.hinglish: Ek baar ki baat hai, ek bahaadur nanhe ne raasta bhooli chidiya ke bachche ko ghonsla dhoondhne mein madad ki. Aur sabne taali bajaayi!

text.en: Tell baby about the little body they are growing this week: fingers, toes, ears, heart.
text.hinglish: Baby ko bataaiye ki is hafte unka nanha sharir kya bana raha hai: ungliyan, angoothe, kaan, dil.

say.en: Ten tiny fingers, ten tiny toes, two little ears, and a heart that goes thump-thump. You are a miracle.
say.hinglish: Das nanhi ungliyan, das nanhe angoothe, do chhote kaan, aur ek dil jo dhak-dhak karta hai. Tum ek chamatkaar ho.

text.en: Make baby one small, real promise you know you can keep.
text.hinglish: Baby se ek chhota, sachcha vaada kijiye jo aap nibha sakti hain.

say.en: I promise to read you a story every night, even if I'm sleepy and it's a very short one.
say.hinglish: Main vaada karti hoon ki har raat tumhe kahani sunaaungi, chahe neend aa rahi ho aur kahani chhoti ho.

text.en: Tell baby about the next festival coming up and how the family will celebrate it.
text.hinglish: Baby ko agle tyohaar ke baare mein bataaiye aur parivaar use kaise manaayega.

say.en: Soon it will be ___. We'll clean the house, light diyas, make sweets, and next year you'll be right here with us.
say.hinglish: Jaldi ___ aayega. Hum ghar saaf karenge, diye jalaayenge, mithaai banaayenge, aur agle saal tum yahin hamaare saath hoge.

text.en: Describe the room where baby will sleep: the light, the bed, the sounds at night.
text.hinglish: Baby ka kamra bataaiye jahan woh soyega: roshni, bistar, raat ki awaazein.

say.en: Your bed will be right next to mine. There's a soft blanket, a little lamp, and the fan humming you to sleep.
say.hinglish: Tumhaara bistar mere bistar ke bilkul paas hoga. Naram kambal, chhota sa lamp, aur pankhe ki gunjan jo tumhe sulaayegi.

text.en: Tell baby about a time you were brave, even when you were scared.
text.hinglish: Baby ko bataaiye ki kab aap dar lagne ke bawajood bahaadur bani thi.

say.en: Once I was scared of ___, but I did it anyway. Being brave just means trying, little one.
say.hinglish: Ek baar mujhe ___ se dar laga, par maine phir bhi kiya. Bahaadur hona matlab koshish karna, mere chhote.

text.en: Say a children's rhyme you remember, slowly, with actions on your belly.
text.hinglish: Koi bachpan ki kavita yaad kijiye aur pet par haath ke ishaaron ke saath dheere boliye.

say.en: Chanda mama door ke, pue pakaaye boor ke. Aap khaayein thaali mein, munne ko de pyaali mein. The moon uncle shares sweets with you!
say.hinglish: Chanda mama door ke, pue pakaaye boor ke. Aap khaayein thaali mein, munne ko de pyaali mein. Chanda mama tumhe bhi mithaai denge!

text.en: Before sleeping, tell baby about tonight's moon and stars.
text.hinglish: Sone se pehle baby ko aaj raat ke chaand aur taaron ke baare mein bataaiye.

say.en: Tonight the moon is a thin smile and the stars are blinking. They're saying good night to you too.
say.hinglish: Aaj raat chaand ek patli muskaan jaisa hai aur taare tim-tima rahe hain. Woh bhi tumhe shubh raatri keh rahe hain.

text.en: Tell baby about a food you love and promise to share it one day.
text.hinglish: Baby ko apne pasandida khaane ke baare mein bataaiye aur ek din saath khaane ka vaada kijiye.

say.en: I love hot bajra roti with white butter and gur. When you're big enough, the first bite is yours!
say.hinglish: Mujhe garam bajra roti, safed makkhan aur gud bahut pasand hai. Jab tum bade hoge, pehla nivaala tumhaara!

text.en: Ask baby a question and imagine their answer out loud. Make it playful.
text.hinglish: Baby se ek sawaal poochhiye aur zor se unka jawaab sochiye. Mazedaar banaaiye.

say.en: Will you like mangoes or bananas more? I think mangoes, because you kick every time I eat one!
say.hinglish: Tumhe aam zyada pasand aayega ya kela? Mujhe lagta hai aam, kyunki jab bhi main khaati hoon tum laat maarte ho!

text.en: Take three slow breaths together, and say one calm sentence after each.
text.hinglish: Saath mein teen dheemi saansein lijiye, aur har saans ke baad ek shaant vaakya boliye.

say.en: Breathe in… we are safe. Breathe out… we are calm. Breathe in… we are loved.
say.hinglish: Saans andar… hum surakshit hain. Saans bahar… hum shaant hain. Saans andar… hum pyaar mein hain.

text.en: Tell baby what you'll do in the very first minute you meet them.
text.hinglish: Baby ko bataaiye ki unse milne ke pehle minute mein aap kya karengi.

say.en: The very first thing I'll do is hold you close, count your fingers, and whisper: 'I've been waiting for you.'
say.hinglish: Sabse pehle main tumhe seene se lagaaungi, tumhaari ungliyan ginungi, aur dheere se kahungi: 'Main tumhaara intezaar kar rahi thi.'

text.en: Put your hand on the belly and say: Hello little one, this is Papa. I can't wait to meet you.
text.hinglish: Pet par haath rakhkar kahiye: Hello chhote, main Papa hoon. Tumse milne ka intezaar hai.

text.en: Tell baby what you did at work or in the fields today.
text.hinglish: Baby ko bataiye ki aaj kaam par ya khet mein kya kiya.

text.en: Tell baby about the first game you will play together.
text.hinglish: Baby ko bataiye ki aap dono milkar pehla kaun sa khel khelenge.

text.en: Tell baby three things you love about Mummy, out loud so she hears too.
text.hinglish: Zor se baby ko Mummy ki teen pyaari baatein bataiye, taaki Mummy bhi sune.

text.en: Read this: A little sparrow carried one drop of water at a time to put out a forest fire. When the elephant laughed, she said, 'I am doing my part.' Be like the sparrow, little one.
text.hinglish: Yeh padhiye: Ek nanhi chidiya jungle ki aag bujhaane ke liye ek-ek boond paani laati rahi. Haathi hansa to boli, 'Main apna hissa kar rahi hoon.' Chidiya jaise banna, chhote.

text.en: Tell baby about your favourite childhood game.
text.hinglish: Baby ko apne bachpan ka pasandida khel bataiye.

text.en: Make baby one promise as a father.
text.hinglish: Ek pita ke roop mein baby se ek vaada kijiye.

text.en: Sing or hum any song to the belly. Baby loves deep voices!
text.hinglish: Pet ke paas koi bhi gaana gaaiye ya gungunaaiye. Baby ko bhaari awaaz pasand aati hai!

text.en: Read this: A thirsty crow found a pot with a little water at the bottom. He dropped pebbles in, one by one, until the water rose. Never give up, little one.
text.hinglish: Yeh padhiye: Ek pyaase kauve ko matke mein thoda sa paani mila. Usne ek-ek kankad daala aur paani upar aa gaya. Kabhi haar mat maanna, chhote.

text.en: Tell baby about the village chaupal and the people there.
text.hinglish: Baby ko gaon ki chaupal aur wahan ke logon ke baare mein bataiye.

text.en: Offer Mummy a gentle foot or shoulder rub tonight, and tell baby you are looking after Mummy.
text.hinglish: Aaj raat Mummy ke pair ya kandhe dabaaiye, aur baby ko bataiye ki aap Mummy ka khayal rakh rahe hain.

text.en: Tell baby something your own father taught you.
text.hinglish: Baby ko woh baat bataiye jo aapke pita ji ne aapko sikhaayi.

text.en: Read this: The hare ran fast and napped. The tortoise walked slowly but never stopped, and won the race. Slow and steady, little one.
text.hinglish: Yeh padhiye: Khargosh tez bhaaga aur so gaya. Kachhua dheere chala par ruka nahi, aur race jeet gaya. Dheere aur lagaataar, chhote.

text.en: Tell baby about the first ride you will take them on: cycle, scooter or tractor!
text.hinglish: Baby ko bataiye ki pehli sawaari kis par karenge: cycle, scooter ya tractor!

text.en: Tell baby what makes you proud of your family.
text.hinglish: Baby ko bataiye ki aapko apne parivaar par kis baat ka garv hai.

text.en: Say a goodnight to baby: Shubh ratri, sweet dreams, Papa is here.
text.hinglish: Baby ko kahiye: Shubh ratri, meethe sapne, Papa yahan hai.

text.en: Do one household job today without being asked, and tell baby about it.
text.hinglish: Aaj bina kahe ghar ka ek kaam kijiye, aur baby ko bataiye.

text.en: Read this: An ant was drowning, and a dove dropped a leaf to save it. Later the ant saved the dove from a hunter. Kindness comes back, little one.
text.hinglish: Yeh padhiye: Ek cheenti doob rahi thi, kabootar ne patta girakar bachaaya. Baad mein cheenti ne kabootar ko shikaari se bachaaya. Bhalaai laut kar aati hai, chhote.

text.en: Tell baby about the night sky over the fields.
text.hinglish: Baby ko kheton ke upar ke raat ke aasmaan ke baare mein bataiye.

text.en: Wait for a kick with your hand on the belly. Tell baby: I felt you!
text.hinglish: Pet par haath rakhkar laat ka intezaar kijiye. Baby ko kahiye: maine tumhe mehsoos kiya!

text.en: How are you feeling today, really?
text.hinglish: Aaj aap sach mein kaisa mehsoos kar rahi hain?

text.en: Write about a moment you felt your baby move.
text.hinglish: Woh pal likhiye jab aapne baby ki harkat mehsoos ki.

text.en: What do you hope your baby will love?
text.hinglish: Aap chahti hain baby ko kya pasand aaye?

text.en: What has this pregnancy taught you so far?
text.hinglish: Is safar ne aapko ab tak kya sikhaaya?

text.en: Dear baby, today I…
text.hinglish: Pyaare baby, aaj maine…

text.en: Who in the family is most excited to meet you, and why?
text.hinglish: Ghar mein tumse milne ko sabse zyada utsuk kaun hai, aur kyon?

text.en: Write one wish for your baby's first year.
text.hinglish: Baby ke pehle saal ke liye ek dua likhiye.

text.en: Write about something that made you feel strong.
text.hinglish: Woh baat likhiye jisne aapko majboot mehsoos karaaya.

text.en: Describe today's weather for your baby to read one day.
text.hinglish: Aaj ka mausam likhiye, taaki baby ek din padhe.

text.en: Thank someone who helped you this week, in writing.
text.hinglish: Is hafte jisne madad ki, unhe likh kar shukriya kahiye.

text.en: Did you have a dream about your baby? Write it down.
text.hinglish: Kya baby ka koi sapna aaya? Likh lijiye.

text.en: Write a letter your child can open on their 18th birthday.
text.hinglish: Ek chitthi likhiye jo baby 18 saal ka hone par khole.

text.en: What food have you been craving? Write about it!
text.hinglish: Aajkal kya khaane ka mann karta hai? Likhiye!

text.en: Write about the names you love and why.
text.hinglish: Jo naam pasand hain unhe aur unki wajah likhiye.

text.en: What helps you feel calm? Write it so you remember.
text.hinglish: Aapko sukoon kis se milta hai? Likhiye taaki yaad rahe.
